home.headline: Mechanical Engineering student at Politecnico di Torino
home.intro: Mechanical engineering student at Politecnico di Torino, studying in the English-taught programme and seeking internships in mechanical and structural engineering. I use programming and 3D modelling to support design, simulation and technical problem solving. I learn quickly and work well in teams that value logic, structure and clear communication.
home.nowIntro: A snapshot of what I'm spending my time on.

items.label: Learning
items.text: Mechanical Engineering at Politecnico di Torino, alongside the [INTRAPRENDENTI](https://www.polito.it/didattica/polito-learning-experiences/learning-experiences-in-interdisciplinarity/percorso-intraprendenti) interdisciplinary honours track. I prefer to use C++, Python and MATLAB for university work and technical projects.

items.label: Making
items.text: Structural design and analysis with [Team Icarus on the Advanced Propulsion Aircraft](https://icarus.polito.it/apa-2025/) project, using SolidWorks, HyperMesh and HyperView. Additionally, I'm part of the [Firmware (IT)](https://icarus.polito.it/it-2025/) section in Team Icarus, where we use [FreeRTOS](https://www.freertos.org/) on [STM32 microcontrollers](https://www.st.com/en/microcontrollers-microprocessors/stm32-32-bit-arm-cortex-mcus.html) to develop proprietary flight control and telemetry systems in C.

items.label: Looking ahead
items.text: Seeking mechanical and structural engineering internships, with availability for internships and travel within Italy and the EU, and preference for Turin.
